text_description: Full-length runway look centered on a fitted black coat-dress or long jacket worn as the main garment, cut close through the shoulders and torso with a defined waist cinched by a narrow matching belt. The piece has a sharp pointed collar, long sleeves, and a straight front opening line, with a dark tonal textured surface that reads as lace, jacquard, or embossed floral/abstract patterning. Dense black tassel-like fringe decorates the center front from neckline downward, the sleeve cuffs, and especially the skirt hem, creating a shaggy, moving border that falls to around knee-to-below-knee length with irregular strands extending lower. The silhouette is structured at the top with padded-looking shoulders and a tailored waist, then slightly straight through the skirt before the heavy fringe adds volume and motion at the lower edge. Styling includes oversized black sunglasses, small dark/metal earrings, a small red textured handbag carried by double chain straps in one hand, and bright red-orange pointed pumps with a dark toe area, adding sharp color contrast against the otherwise all-black outfit.
